evidence: The idShape regex now permits `@`, `[` and `]` only after a first letter or digit, so a value starting with `[` or `@` is still rejected, which is what the new comment claims.
In a YAML block scalar these characters are plain-scalar characters, and the regex still forbids spaces, quotes and commas, so the widened set introduces no YAML defect that the diff shows.
The new test checks that the table read returns the bracketed id and that the generated Claude and Pi files carry the ids verbatim.
The comment on the OpenCode runtime constants is documentation only and changes no behavior.
